subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] mm/page_alloc: move the kswapd node skip check into a helper

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch refactors the kswapd node skip check from the get_page_from_freelist function into a separate helper function called should_skip_kswapd_zone. This makes the zone iteration cleaner to read and resolves a checkpatch warning about an unexplained lockless use of waitqueue_active(). The function is moved without any functional changes, making it easier to understand and maintain in the future.
